description: This file defines the PageParams class, which extends BaseParam and manages pagination parameters ('size' and 'number') for API V8. It includes methods to retrieve these parameters with default values and configures validation rules for them using Symfony's OptionsResolver and Validator components.

classes.name: PageParams
classes.description: Class for handling and validating pagination parameters ('size' and 'number') in API V8 requests.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the 'size' parameter value, defaulting to BeanManager::DEFAULT_ALL_RECORDS if not set.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Returns the 'number' parameter value, defaulting to BeanManager::DEFAULT_OFFSET if not set.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Configures validation rules for 'size' and 'number' parameters using Symfony's OptionsResolver and Validator constraints.
